comment: Demo MF-TDMA return link (plan/demo/mftdma): QPSK bursts on three carriers at 250 and 500 kBd, each carrier cut
into its bursts (rpps.sync.Bursts), each burst decimated to 4 samples a symbol, matched filtered and timed on its
own, its type found by its unique word (one of three:
the frame sync's `word`), its carrier offset and phase taken off on the word;
then the type's LDPC units (802.11n (648,324)), a scrambler running across the burst, and the terminal, sequence
number, payload and CRC-16. With the plan each burst is placed in it (superframe, frame, slot, tx type), the
plan's origin acquired from the bursts; transmitting, the plan places each burst on its slot.
The capture is 8 MS/s around the plan's centre

sps.comment: samples a symbol of every carrier's bursts

plan.comment: the burst time plan ("": none, detection only, with `carriers`)

carriers.comment: the carriers [{freq, width, rate}] when there is no plan (detection only); [] takes the plan's

requires.comment: the slower carriers' symbol rate; the capture spans the plan's carriers at 8 MS/s

steps.comment: what the word left of the carrier, from decisions: block estimation tracked across 32-symbol windows
